scientific_integrity: Full analytic proof and executable exact-rational auxiliary checks are included; no independent certification or authorship is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Uniform one-dimensional grids with n divisible by 3, independent sphere blocks, deterministic C^3 integrands. Not a worst-case optimality theorem; the spherical copula is prior work. Priority independently unverified.
title: A sphere-coupled randomized trapezoid is quadratically exact and has sharp cubic-order variance
